excerpts.content:
ok found the real root cause:
- it is related to slow db commit times per block
- these have been triggered by the recent large code attacks by Pawel and Jochem
- note this is not related to the jumpdest analysis runtime times (that is a separate topic about NewPayloads)
- this is about post block execution commit of writes to the DB (affects our FCU request processing badly)
- we're looking into improvements for this this week
